title: Analytics Potentialmfaspam
author: ep3p
description: This query can help you to detect unexpected requests for MFA, because for example the user has declined the MFA request, or several requests were left unresponded Click "Save as function", in Parameters write in the fields: "timespan" "query_frequency" "1h" "timespan" "query_period"    "14d" If you name the function "PotentialMFASpam", you can check the function with queries like the following: PotentialMFASpam() PotentialMFASpam(1h, 14d) let query_frequency = 1h; let query_period = 14d; // A CorrelationId can extend over several weeks let Function = (query_frequency:timespan = 1h, query_period:timespan = 14d){
